description: This file defines the MDB2_LOB class, a stream wrapper implementation for handling Large Object (LOB) support in the MDB2 database abstraction layer for PHP. It includes methods for opening, reading, telling position, checking EOF, seeking, and closing streams related to LOBs.

classes.name: MDB2_LOB
classes.description: A stream wrapper class for handling Large Object (LOB) support in MDB2, providing methods for stream operations such as open, read, tell, eof, seek, stat, and close.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream for a LOB, parsing the URL to identify the database and LOB index.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the LOB stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Stub for writing to the stream, currently not implemented, returns 0.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the LOB stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the LOB stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seek operation for the stream, not implemented, always returns false.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns information about the stream, such as database and LOB indices.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream and destroys the associated LOB.
